details.completeness_justification: All HIGH importance criteria (K1-K6) are adequately represented in the candidate summary with core material meaning covered. K7 (MEDIUM) is missing as there is no mention of March 2025 senior secured bond tap or North Macedonia tax refund events. The summary captures record financial performance metrics, key improvements in capitalization and leverage ratios, major performance drivers (organic growth, Sub-Saharan integration, digital transformation), business segment details, capital structure transformation via IPO, and strategic priorities for 2025. No material omissions change the overall understanding of the report.
details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary is internally coherent. All statements build logically upon each other without contradictions. Key performance metrics (revenue, EBITDA, profit) show consistent growth trends. Explanations for variances (e.g., Romanian VAT impact) are clearly presented. The summary flows from overall performance to specific metrics, portfolio quality, capital structure, and future priorities. No material logical gaps, contradictions, or organizational issues are present. While some numerical relationships (e.g., segment totals) aren't explicitly reconciled, the candidate does not claim exhaustive additivity, so this does not constitute an internal contradiction.
